not_for: Music Producers looking for advanced mixing

overview.positioning: The complete guide to launching a professional-sounding podcast from scratch.
overview.short_description: Learn to develop a show concept, record crisp audio, edit efficiently, and distribute your podcast to Apple, Spotify, and beyond.

key_facts.capstone: Launch Episode 1 and a podcast trailer to major platforms.

what_you_will_be_able_to_do: Format and structure engaging podcast episodes.
Record high-quality audio locally and remotely.
Edit audio, remove background noise, and add intro/outro music.
Publish and distribute the podcast via RSS feeds.

why_now.industry_shift: Audio consumption continues to rise; podcasts are a key networking and marketing tool.
why_now.ai_impact: Tools like Descript allow text-based audio editing, drastically reducing production time.
why_now.business_demand: B2B companies use podcasts for thought leadership and lead generation.
why_now.career_opportunity: Growing demand for freelance podcast editors.

learning_outcomes: PLAN: A unique show concept and episode structure.
RECORD: Professional audio using affordable gear.
EDIT: Polish episodes using Audacity or Descript.
DISTRIBUTE: Manage podcast hosting and RSS feeds.

business_use_cases.business_problem: Need to build authority in a niche industry.
business_use_cases.approach: Launch an interview podcast featuring industry leaders.
business_use_cases.output: A thought leadership asset and networking tool.

ai_integration.ai_can_assist_with: Noise reduction, text-based editing, show notes generation.
ai_integration.validation_protocol: Listen to the final export to catch AI glitches.
ai_integration.responsible_use: Ensure guest consent for AI transcriptions.

best_practices: Always record remote guests on separate tracks.
Use a dynamic microphone for untreated rooms.
Write compelling show notes for SEO.

common_mistakes.why_it_happens: Focusing on the mic rather than the environment.
common_mistakes.professional_approach: Treat the room with soft furnishings or record in a closet.

career_paths.employer_expectations: Ability to deliver clean, professional audio on a deadline.
career_paths.what_student_demonstrates: A launched podcast available on major platforms.

freelance_applications.client_workflow: Receive raw files -> Edit & Mix -> Write notes -> Schedule upload.
freelance_applications.portfolio_requirements: Audio samples before and after editing.

what_you_will_build: A podcast show concept and cover art.
A fully edited trailer and Episode 1.
final_deliverables: A live podcast feed on Spotify and Apple Podcasts.

assessment.criteria: Audio clarity, editing flow, and professional packaging.

certification.title: Certified Podcast Producer
certification.criteria: Launch a podcast with at least 1 trailer and 1 episode.
certification.verification: Review of the live RSS feed.

faq.question: Do I need an expensive microphone?
faq.answer: No, a $60 USB dynamic microphone is perfect for starting out.

faq.question: Is podcasting too saturated?
faq.answer: While there are many podcasts, highly niched, high-quality shows still have a massive opportunity.

modules.module_purpose: Define the show and capture the best possible audio.

lessons.why_it_matters: A clear concept attracts a dedicated listener base.

lessons.what_is_taught: Dynamic vs Condenser mics, and reducing echo.
lessons.why_it_matters: Fixing bad audio in post is difficult; capture it right at the source.

modules.assignment: Submit raw audio of the trailer.

modules.module_purpose: Polish the audio and share it with the world.

lessons.what_is_taught: Cutting mistakes, pacing, and noise reduction.
lessons.why_it_matters: Keeps the listener engaged without distractions.

lessons.what_is_taught: Adding intro/outro music and leveling volume (LUFS).
lessons.why_it_matters: Ensures the podcast sounds professional and consistent.

lessons.what_is_taught: Designing art in Canva and setting up a podcast host.
lessons.why_it_matters: Distributes the show to Apple, Spotify, etc.
lessons.what_learner_does: Uploads the show and submits the RSS feed.

modules.assignment: Submit the link to the live podcast.
